name: Fixed-budget wider-history ToMe for SAM2 memory attention
status: engineering gate required; no full-cohort efficacy run authorized by this protocol
question: At SAM2's native saturated spatial-key budget, does reading up to 12 past frames with per-frame local ToMe improve full-video segmentation over the native six-frame reader, and does soft region-aware matching help beyond generic ToMe?

prior_work.paper: Token Merging: Your ViT but Faster, ICLR 2023

hypothesis: A fixed total memory-attention token budget can cover a longer temporal history by merging locally redundant tokens within each frame. Soft predicted-region similarity may reduce harmful merging across object, background, and boundary-related locations, without selecting frames by quality.

scope.independence_note: Sequence-level patient independence has not been verified; PolypGen results are exploratory.

method.terminology: This expands the fixed memory-attention read history; it does not increase persistent per-video bank storage.

native_capacity.object_pointers: excluded from the spatial budget and copied unchanged

candidate_capacity.quota_rule: For 1..6 available nonconditioning maps, retain each full 4096-token map. For 7..12 maps, divide 24576 evenly across maps; assign remainder tokens to the most recent maps. The conditioning map stays dense.

method.frame_schedule: Use SAM2's fixed nearest-history schedule, extended to 12 maps. Do not rank or reject frames by quality, confidence, or prediction outcome.
method.temporal_position: Preserve native age slots for ages 1..6; repeat the native oldest slot for ages 7..12. Keep each frame as a separate span. This is a coarse old-history encoding, not distinct age encoding beyond six frames.
method.read_location: At the SDPA boundary, after native K/V projection and spatial RoPE. Preserve native image features, memory writes, decoder, object pointers, and all pretrained SAM2 weights.

matching.source: Pinned upstream ToMe bipartite soft matching and weighted merge.
matching.locality: Non-overlapping 4x4 token windows within each individual frame; never merge tokens across frames.
matching.regional_condition: Normalize the mean-head projected-key metric and the predicted soft foreground/background/boundary-role vector; concatenate each scaled by 1/sqrt(2), giving a fixed equal contribution to cosine similarity. This is an explicit exploratory design choice, not a literature-established optimum.
matching.budget_matching: Generic and region-aware arms use the same formula-derived per-frame quota and same per-window merge count, independent of role assignments.

method.attention_mass: Use ToMe weighted means for post-RoPE K/V and additive log(cluster mass) in SDPA logits; pointers have mass one. This is approximate for distinct K/V vectors.
method.training: None. All SAM2 weights are frozen; no learned parameters are added.

checks: Fresh SAM2 replay matches the archived native prediction and stored-memory hashes through every read with at most six available nonconditioning maps.
At later reads, at most 12 nonconditioning frames are present and the conditioning map remains dense.
With 7..12 nonconditioning maps, the total spatial key count is exactly 28672 for both candidate arms; pointers are unchanged and additional.
Generic and regional controls have identical quotas for every source frame and every 4x4 window at every attention layer.
All four native memory-attention layers are intercepted once per target; outputs and memory state remain finite; parameters and temporal-slot table are restored exactly.
ToMe source revision and digest match the pinned upstream checkout.
Synthetic identical-key/value SDPA output is conserved under the cluster-mass correction.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice over complete post-prompt videos for all 21 eligible sequences.
planned_contrasts: regional fixed-budget wider history vs native
regional fixed-budget wider history vs generic fixed-budget wider history
evaluation.statistics: Paired sequence bootstrap 95% intervals and paired sequence-level tests, with Holm correction for the two planned contrasts.
evaluation.meaningful_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice versus native and positive versus matched generic; at least 14/21 sequence wins versus native; positive 95% lower bounds and Holm-adjusted p<0.05 for both contrasts; no increase in pooled GT-empty false alarms.
evaluation.decision: Do not run the cohort until the real-frame engineering gate passes. If the gate passes, run the three-arm cohort once under this frozen protocol.

limitations: The experiment changes which fixed-schedule past maps are read, so any gain would support longer-history coverage under a fixed attention budget, not ToMe in isolation; native and generic controls separate these effects.
The region labels are predicted spatial roles, not proof of semantic purity of feature vectors.
Averaging different post-RoPE keys is approximate even with mass correction.
SAM2 does not provide distinct learned temporal slots beyond six history positions; repeating the oldest slot is an explicit limitation.
This design is a hypothesis and does not guarantee a Dice improvement.
